verdicts.reason: A: all copy (J'adore Paris, LAVANDER, SKINCARE, HOMEMADE LOTION) is strung along a top row outside the label frame, which sits empty except for orphaned divider rules; the illustration row is shrunk to a tiny, unreadable strip floating on the right, and the brand lockup and imagery are lost. B is also broken: the text is scattered down a left column with big gaps, LAVANDER is undersized, SKINCARE is tiny, the label frame is empty with stray rules, and the illustrations are spread out and pixelated. Still, B keeps the illustration band at a recognisable size and the text in reading order, so it is less bad.
